tracking_config.reference_set: Clean pipeline ratio-test matches with GT error <= 3 px (per pair, detector)

link_status.lost: no condition location within link_radius of the clean location
link_status.unique: exactly one condition location within link_radius AND that location has exactly one clean location within link_radius
link_status.ambiguous: any other case with >= 1 candidate (reported separately, excluded from displacement statistics)

tracking_config.chance_baseline: same rule applied to clean locations shifted by (+-20,0) and (0,+-20) px (shifted points kept only inside the valid region)
tracking_config.outside_set: GT-correct matches whose reference keypoint is not in the reference set, split by whether the target keypoint links to any clean location

fixed_landmark_h.landmarks: reference-set correspondences whose clean target location is UNIQUELY linked in both the B-detection and the R-detection of the same cell
fixed_landmark_h.estimator: cv2.findHomography(method=0) on all landmarks (least squares + LM refinement; identity and count fixed, no RANSAC)
fixed_landmark_h.label: diagnostic (uses Clean + GT); not a matching result

oracle_inlier_h.rule: cv2.findHomography(method=0) on all GT-correct (<=3 px) ratio-test matches of a condition; min 8
oracle_inlier_h.label: diagnostic (uses GT); not a matching result
